text: The Bank of Kyoto, Ltd. moved to a holding-company structure on 2 October 2023, and current investor information for the bank is published on the Kyoto Financial Group, Inc. website; Kyoto Financial Group's group-companies page lists the Bank of Kyoto as a group company.
short: The Bank of Kyoto is under Kyoto Financial Group, Inc. (holding-company structure since 2 October 2023).

source.name: 株式会社京都銀行: 株主・投資家のみなさま (The Bank of Kyoto: for shareholders and investors)
source.quote: 2023年10月2日より、京都銀行は持株会社体制へ移行しました。 最新のIR情報は「京都フィナンシャルグループ」のホームページでご案内しています。
source.note: 持株会社体制 = holding-company structure. Page without a date; the 2 October 2023 transition date is on the page.

additionalSources.quote: 株式会社京都銀行 京都市下京区烏丸通松原上る薬師前町700番地
additionalSources.note: KFG's group companies list includes 株式会社京都銀行 (The Bank of Kyoto, Ltd.), business: banking. Page without a date.
